orchestrator.description: Directs research, synthesizes findings, reviews build output

worker.description: Gathers information and builds from synthesized plan

steps.label: Research
steps.description: Gather information relevant to the brief. Write findings to context/research-findings.md. Update context/status.md when done.

steps.label: Synthesize
steps.description: Read context/research-findings.md. Distill into an actionable plan in context/build-plan.md. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Build
steps.description: Read context/build-plan.md. Implement based on the synthesized plan. Commit frequently. Update context/status.md when done.
